series.label: WTI Crude
series.note: WTI settled NEGATIVE on 20 April 2020 (−$37.63). The band allows it because it happened; a floor at zero would reject a real print.

series.label: Electricity (IEX day-ahead)
series.note: The day's AVERAGE market clearing price across all 96 fifteen-minute blocks. Indian spot power swings from roughly ₹1,100 to the ₹10,000 ceiling within a single day, so no one block is 'the price'.

series.label: Zinc
series.note: The band starts at 50 because zinc genuinely traded near $180/t through the 1960s. An earlier 200 floor blocked eighteen real observations — the gate working correctly against a band that was wrong.

series.label: Iron Ore (cfr spot)
series.note: Quoted per DRY METRIC TONNE UNIT (dmtu), the World Bank's own basis — one percent of iron content per tonne. It is not the $/tonne headline the trade press quotes, and the two differ by roughly the ore grade.

series.label: US 10 Year Treasury
series.note: CBOE's 10-year Treasury yield index — the yield itself, in percent, not a price.

series.label: US 13 Week T-Bill
series.note: The short end of the US curve. `tenorYears` on the curve view places it at 0.25.

absent.label: Coking Coal
absent.absent: Neither a free daily feed nor the World Bank Pink Sheet carries coking (metallurgical) coal — the Pink Sheet publishes thermal coal only. It needs a commercial source such as Platts or Argus.

absent.label: CRB Commodity Index
absent.absent: Refinitiv/CoreCommodity proprietary — no free feed at any frequency. The Bloomberg Commodity Index is carried alongside as a comparable basket, under its own name.

absent.label: Baltic Dry Index
absent.absent: Baltic Exchange licenses the BDI; no free API publishes it. Queued for the Phase 1 aggregator harvest.

absent.label: Container Freight Index
absent.absent: Freightos FBX and Drewry WCI publish weekly on their own pages with no API. Queued for the Phase 1 aggregator harvest.

absent.label: Rail Freight
absent.absent: Indian Railways freight volumes come from the Ministry of Railways monthly release — Phase 2 India harvest.

absent.label: SIP Contributions
absent.absent: The AMFI monthly workbook now read for MF flows, folios and AUM does not carry SIP contributions, and the monthly-report page links no SIP file. It is published separately and needs its own source located.

absent.label: India petroleum products consumption
absent.absent: PPAC publishes consumption monthly and CURRENT — its July 2026 flash report was on the site when this was checked — but as PDF only, with no spreadsheet or API alongside. It needs a reader for that report's layout, not a URL.

absent.label: India vehicle sales
absent.absent: SIAM puts its production and sales statistics behind a member subscription — the public pages carry login and subscription prompts and no data. This one is a commercial licence, not a reader.
